label: Goodness, will and OPEN volitional bridges yield willing GOOD_4 to all existing
description: Analyst registration of the PR #1458 q.20 a.2 reconstruction, attribution deferred. Fix one GOD_4 g with will and one x in act in esse; the witness respect is esse, x being good there by the coextension of good and actuality (00e962ae). If x is not g, supreme goodness (e0dae79f) gives that g causes x in esse, and the OPEN bridge CausalExistenceWilling turns that causation by a God with will into willing x's existence-good to x. If x is g, supreme goodness gives g's goodness in esse and the OPEN DivineOwnGoodWilling bridge gives g's willing of it to itself. The self/other split uses an explicit DecidableEq instance on the carrier (a decision procedure for identity, not a philosophical premise), so the proof is zero-axiom. Neither bridge follows from causation, having will or supreme goodness; the finite LoveControls in DivineLoveBridge keep goodness, will and coextension fixed and drop each bridge in turn.
